decisions.difference: A: (clinical_finding (snomed_concept "Sexual assault" "event"))  vs  B: (clinical_finding (snomed_concept "Victim of forced sexual activity" "finding"))
decisions.reason: The page defines sexual assault/rape as "forced to do any form of sexual act without consent", which is what Victim of forced sexual activity (a finding, descendant of Victim of abuse) names; Sexual assault is an event, not a finding about the patient.
The red box gives different windows "if woman" and "if man", so sex must be checked for.
"old/new scars" is a clinical finding on the patient; the disorder concept is in the clinical-finding hierarchy, the morphologic abnormality is not.

decisions.difference: A: (clinical_finding (snomed_concept "Withdrawn" "finding") (qualifier (snomed_concept "Severe (severity modifier)" "qualifier value")))  vs  B: (clinical_finding (snomed_concept "Withdrawn behavior" "finding"))
decisions.reason: "excessively withdrawn": Withdrawn behavior (abnormal social behaviour) is the right sense (Withdrawn is a level-of-interest finding), and A's Severe qualifier keeps "excessively".

decisions.difference: A: (clinical_finding (snomed_concept "Fearful mood" "finding") (qualifier (snomed_concept "Severe (severity modifier)" "qualifier value")))  vs  B: (clinical_finding (snomed_concept "Fearful mood" "finding"))
decisions.reason: "excessively ... fearful": the Severe qualifier keeps "excessively"; unqualified counts any degree.
"excessively ... anxious": the Severe qualifier keeps "excessively"; unqualified counts any degree.

decisions.difference: A: (<= (onset (clinical_finding (snomed_concept "Sexual assault" "event"))) (time_ago 5 days))  vs  B: (or (and Female (<= (onset (clinical_finding (snomed_concept "Victim of forced sexual activity" "finding"))) (time_ago 5 days))) (and Male (<= (onset (clinical_finding (snomed_concept "Victim of forced sexual activity" "finding"))) (time_ago 3 days))))
decisions.final_expr: (and (clinical_finding (snomed_concept "Female" "finding")) (<= (onset (clinical_finding (snomed_concept "Victim of forced sexual activity" "finding"))) (time_ago 5 days))) / (and (clinical_finding (snomed_concept "Male" "finding")) (<= (onset (clinical_finding (snomed_concept "Victim of forced sexual activity" "finding"))) (time_ago 3 days)))
decisions.reason: The red box says "within last 5 days if woman or last 3 days if man"; A's 5 days for everyone over-fires for men on days 4-5.

decisions.difference: A: (clinical_finding (snomed_concept "Strange and inexplicable behavior" "finding"))  vs  B: (clinical_finding (snomed_concept "Abnormal behavior" "finding"))
decisions.reason: "behaviour seems strange": Abnormal behavior carries the synonym "strange behaviour"; A's narrower concept adds "inexplicable", which the page does not say.

decisions.difference: A: (clinical_finding (snomed_concept "Sexual assault" "event"))  vs  B: (clinical_finding (snomed_concept "Victim of forced sexual activity" "finding"))
decisions.reason: "If forced to do any form of sexual act without consent" is exactly Victim of forced sexual activity.
Same as the check_for decision: "old/new scars" as a clinical finding.

decisions.difference: A: (clinical_finding (snomed_concept "Withdrawn" "finding") (qualifier (snomed_concept "Severe (severity modifier)" "qualifier value")))  vs  B: (clinical_finding (snomed_concept "Withdrawn behavior" "finding"))
decisions.reason: Same as the check_for decision for "excessively withdrawn".

decisions.difference: A: (clinical_finding (snomed_concept "Fearful mood" "finding") (qualifier (snomed_concept "Severe (severity modifier)" "qualifier value")))  vs  B: (clinical_finding (snomed_concept "Fearful mood" "finding"))
decisions.reason: Same as the check_for decision for "excessively ... fearful".
Same as the check_for decision for "excessively ... anxious".

decisions.difference: A: physical assault alone, and intimidation/threats alone, suffice (ungated)  vs  B: every physical and emotional limb gated on the abuse context (Victim of abuse or Victim of psychological trauma)
decisions.reason: The Assess table is for "the traumatised/abused patient", so B's uniform gate follows the page; Victim of physical assault is-a Victim of abuse so that limb fires the same either way, and Intimidation sits under Aggressive behavior so ungated it could fire on an aggressive patient.

notes: Base B (both builds passed). B encodes the red box's sex-specific windows (woman 5 days / man 3 days), which A collapsed to 5 days. Taken from A: the Severe (severity modifier) qualifier for "excessively" withdrawn/fearful/anxious, applied to B's Withdrawn behavior concept. The two builds agreed on the trigger, the four diagnoses and the suicide/injury limbs. Remaining questions from both builders merged; A's "enforce 3 days for men" question is resolved by the final build and dropped; new questions on the severity qualifier and on Intimidation (under Aggressive behavior in SNOMED) added.
